abilities.name: Scryer of Fates (Psychic)
abilities.text: if your army includes this model, after both players have deployed their armies, you can select up to 3 ^^**Thousand Sons^^** units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

abilities.name: Arch-Sorcerer of Tzeentch (Psychic)
abilities.text: Each time this model attempts a Ritual, add 1 to the Psychic test result.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.text: This model can be attached to the following unit: ^^**Rubric Marines, Tzaangor Enlightened, Tzaangor Enlightened with Fatecaster Greatbows^^**

abilities.name: Mortal Sorcery (Aura)
abilities.text: While a friendly ^^**Scintillating Legions Psyker^^** unit from your army is within 6" of and visible to this unit, that ^^**Scintillating Legions^^** unit has the Cabal of Sorcerers ability.

abilities.name: Cabal of Sorcerers
abilities.text:
If your army Faction is ^^**Thousand Sons^^**, at the start of your Shooting phase, one or more models from your army with this ability can attempt Rituals. To do so, select one model from your army with this ability that has not yet attempted a Ritual this turn and select one Ritual no model from your army has attempted to manifest this turn, then take a Psychic test by following the sequence below:

1. Roll 2D6
2. Optionally, roll one additional D6 (Channel the Warp). Then, if one or more doubles or triples were rolled during this test, that model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
3. If that model is not destroyed, the combined total of all the dice rolled during this test is the Psychic test result. If this equals or exceeds the Warp Charge value of the Ritual being attempted, that model manifests that Ritual and you resolve its effects.

abilities.name: Assault Ramp
abilities.text: Each time a unit disembarks from this ^^**Transport^^** after it has made a Normal move, that unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.

abilities.name: Crystalline Body
abilities.text: Each time a ranged attack is allocated to this model, on an unmodified saving throw of 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound after it has finished making its attacks.

abilities.name: Warp Strider
abilities.text: Add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in this model's unit, and each time a model in this model's unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move horizontally through models and terrain features. If this model is wholly within your opponent's deployment zone at the end of the battle, roll one D6: on a 4+, this model gains 1 Arcana point.

abilities.name: Forewarned by Fate
abilities.text: Once per battle round, when an attack is allocated to the bearer's unit, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0. If this model is within range of an objective marker that you control at the end of the battle, and that objective marker is not within your deployment zone, roll one D6: on a 4+ this model gains 1 Lore point.

abilities.name: Flesh Sigils
abilities.text: This model has the Feel Not Pain 5+ ability (if this model is a **^^Chaos Spawn^^** model, it has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead).

abilities.name: Flame-wreathed
abilities.text: Each time this model makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Raptorial Talons
abilities.text: Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of this model's melee weapons by 1.

abilities.name: Immaterial Edge
abilities.text: This model's melee weapons have the **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** ability.

abilities.name: Temporal Distortion
abilities.text: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this model's unit.

abilities.name: Aura of Illusion
abilities.text: This model has the Stealth ability, and while this model is leading a unit, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, if the attacking model is not within 12", subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Malevolence
abilities.text: At the end of the battle, this model gains 1XP and 1 Lore or Arcana point (your choice) for each different Agenda your opponent selected at the start of the battle that one or more of their units subsequently gained XP from.

abilities.name: Mirrored Machinator
abilities.text: In the Determine Victor step, if you are not the victor, roll one D6 for each model from your Crusade army with this reward that is on the battlefield. If one or more of those results are a 4+, you gain that battle's Victor Bonus anyway.

abilities.name: Exalted Mutation (Instant)
abilities.text: This model gains one Boon of Tzeentch of your choosing, or two randomly determined Boons of Tzeentch.

abilities.name: Touch of Vicissitude
abilities.text: Each time this model's unit is selected to fight, select one of the following abilities: **[LETHAL HITS]**; **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]**. Until the end of the phase, this model's melee weapons have the selected ability.

abilities.name: Empyric Portents
abilities.text: In the Determine Attacker and Defender step, if your Crusade army includes one or more models with this reward, do not roll off to determine the Attacker and Defender. Instead, you choose whether you will be the Attacker or Defender (if your opponent has a rule to the same effect, roll off as normal).

abilities.name: Guided by the Whispers
abilities.text: In the Select Crusade Blessings step, roll one D6 for each model from your Crusade army with this reward: if one or more of those result is a 4+, you can select one additional Crusade Blessing this battle.

abilities.name: Time Flux (Instant)
abilities.text:
You can either remove all Battle Scars this model has, or select one other ^^**Thousand Sons**^^ unit on your Order &
of Battle and remove one Battle Scar from that unit.

abilities.name: Psyncopation
abilities.text: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this model's unit.

abilities.name: Immaterial Echo (Psychic)
abilities.text: Each time this model manifests the Temporal Surge Ritual, if the Psychic test result for that Ritual was 12+, you can select two friendly **^^Thousand Sons^^** units that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and within 24" of and visible to this model, instead of one. Each of those units can make a Normal move up to 6". Until the end of the turn, neither of those units are eligible to declare a charge.

abilities.name: Grand Schemer (Instant)
abilities.text: Roll one D6: on a 1-3, you gain 1RP;on a 4-6, you gain D3RP.

abilities.name: Seeded Strategy
abilities.text: Each time your opponent uses a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 5, you gain 1CP; on a 6, you gain 1CP and this model gains 1 Lore point.

abilities.name: Ulterior Ruse
abilities.text: In the Select Agendas step, roll one D6 for each model from your Crusade army with this reward: if one or more of those results is a 2+, you can select one additional **^^Thousand Sons^^** Agenda this battle; if one or more of those results is a 5+, you can select two additional **^^Thousand Sons^^** Agendas instead, this battle.

abilities.name: Opus Arcana (Instant)
abilities.text: You can deduct 1 or 2 Lore points from this model: if you deduct 1, this model gains D3 Arcana points; if you deduct 2, this model gains 3 Arcana points.

abilities.name: Occult Fixation (Psychic)
abilities.text: Each time this model Channels the Warp, add 1 to the result of that Psychic test.

abilities.name: Kaleidoscopic Blast (Psychic)
abilities.text: Each time this model manifests the Doombolt Ritual, if the Psychic test result for that Ritual was 14+, you can select two enemy units that are within 24" of and visible to this model, instead of one (all other restrictions apply). Both selected units suffer D3+3 mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Ardent Scholar
abilities.text: Each time this model is Marked for Greatness, roll one D6: on a 1-2, this model gains 1 Lore point; on a 3-5, this model gains D3 Lore points; on a 6, this model gains D3 Lore points and D3XP.

abilities.name: Sacrificial Grimoire (Instant)
abilities.text: You can deduct 1 or 2 Arcana points from this model: if you deduct 1, this model gains D3 Lore points; if you deduct 2, this model gains 3 Lore points.

abilities.name: Thief of Enigmas (Psychic)
abilities.text: Each time this model manifests the Destiny's Ruin Ritual, if the Psychic test result for that Ritual was 13+, you can select two enemy units that are within 24" of and visible to this model, instead of one. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly **^^Thousand Sons^^** unit makes an attack that targets one of those units, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Destiny's Aberration (Instant)
abilities.text: Select either this model or one other ^^**Thousand Sons^^** unit (excluding ^^**Characters^^**) from your Crusade army that has one or more Battle Traits, then select one Battle Trait the selected model/unit has and replace it with one new ^^**Thousand Sons^^** Battle Trait (this must be one it can have).

abilities.name: Arch Instigator
abilities.text: Add 2 to this model's Wounds characteristic.

abilities.name: Fickle Revelation
abilities.text: At the end of the Declare Battle Formations step, select one **^^Thousand Sons^^** Battle Trait (this can be a **^^Rubricae^^** Battle Trait, even though this model does not have that keyword, but it must otherwise be a Battle Trait this model can have and cannot be a Battle Trait this model, or the unit it is attached to, already has). Until the end of the battle, this models (and any unit it is attached to) is considered to have that Battle Trait.

abilities.name: Artful Dualism (Instant)
abilities.text: This model can either use the Renowned Heroes Requisition once, for 0RP (even if it has not gained a Crusade rank), or it can gain one Artificer or Antiquity Crusade Relic of your choice.

abilities.name: Misinformator (Battle Honour)
abilities.text: After both players have deployed their armies, you can select one **^^Thousand Sons^^** unit from your Crusade army and redeploy it. When doing so, you can set that unit up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-5 wounds remaining
abilities.text: While this model has 1-5 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.text: Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets a ^^**Monster^^** or ^^**Vehicle^^** unit that was hit by one or more Psychic attacks made by a ^^**Thousand Sons Psyker^^** unit from your army this turn, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Damage roll.

abilities.name: Malevolence
abilities.text: At the end of the battle, this model gains 1XP and 1 Lore or Arcana point (your choice) for each different Agenda your opponent selected at the start of the battle that one or more of their units subsequently gained XP from.

abilities.name: Mirrored Machinator
abilities.text: In the Determine Victor step, if you are not the victor, roll one D6 for each model from your Crusade army with this reward that is on the battlefield. If one or more of those results are a 4+, you gain that battle's Victor Bonus anyway.

abilities.name: Exalted Mutation (Instant)
abilities.text: This model gains one Boon of Tzeentch of your choosing, or two randomly determined Boons of Tzeentch.

abilities.name: Touch of Vicissitude
abilities.text: Each time this model's unit is selected to fight, select one of the following abilities: **[LETHAL HITS]**; **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]**. Until the end of the phase, this model's melee weapons have the selected ability.

abilities.name: Empyric Portents
abilities.text: In the Determine Attacker and Defender step, if your Crusade army includes one or more models with this reward, do not roll off to determine the Attacker and Defender. Instead, you choose whether you will be the Attacker or Defender (if your opponent has a rule to the same effect, roll off as normal).

abilities.name: Guided by the Whispers
abilities.text: In the Select Crusade Blessings step, roll one D6 for each model from your Crusade army with this reward: if one or more of those result is a 4+, you can select one additional Crusade Blessing this battle.

abilities.name: Time Flux (Instant)
abilities.text:
You can either remove all Battle Scars this model has, or select one other ^^**Thousand Sons**^^ unit on your Order &
of Battle and remove one Battle Scar from that unit.

abilities.name: Psyncopation
abilities.text: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this model's unit.

abilities.name: Immaterial Echo (Psychic)
abilities.text: Each time this model manifests the Temporal Surge Ritual, if the Psychic test result for that Ritual was 12+, you can select two friendly **^^Thousand Sons^^** units that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and within 24" of and visible to this model, instead of one. Each of those units can make a Normal move up to 6". Until the end of the turn, neither of those units are eligible to declare a charge.

abilities.name: Grand Schemer (Instant)
abilities.text: Roll one D6: on a 1-3, you gain 1RP;on a 4-6, you gain D3RP.

abilities.name: Seeded Strategy
abilities.text: Each time your opponent uses a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 5, you gain 1CP; on a 6, you gain 1CP and this model gains 1 Lore point.

abilities.name: Ulterior Ruse
abilities.text: In the Select Agendas step, roll one D6 for each model from your Crusade army with this reward: if one or more of those results is a 2+, you can select one additional **^^Thousand Sons^^** Agenda this battle; if one or more of those results is a 5+, you can select two additional **^^Thousand Sons^^** Agendas instead, this battle.

abilities.name: Opus Arcana (Instant)
abilities.text: You can deduct 1 or 2 Lore points from this model: if you deduct 1, this model gains D3 Arcana points; if you deduct 2, this model gains 3 Arcana points.

abilities.name: Occult Fixation (Psychic)
abilities.text: Each time this model Channels the Warp, add 1 to the result of that Psychic test.

abilities.name: Kaleidoscopic Blast (Psychic)
abilities.text: Each time this model manifests the Doombolt Ritual, if the Psychic test result for that Ritual was 14+, you can select two enemy units that are within 24" of and visible to this model, instead of one (all other restrictions apply). Both selected units suffer D3+3 mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Ardent Scholar
abilities.text: Each time this model is Marked for Greatness, roll one D6: on a 1-2, this model gains 1 Lore point; on a 3-5, this model gains D3 Lore points; on a 6, this model gains D3 Lore points and D3XP.

abilities.name: Sacrificial Grimoire (Instant)
abilities.text: You can deduct 1 or 2 Arcana points from this model: if you deduct 1, this model gains D3 Lore points; if you deduct 2, this model gains 3 Lore points.

abilities.name: Thief of Enigmas (Psychic)
abilities.text: Each time this model manifests the Destiny's Ruin Ritual, if the Psychic test result for that Ritual was 13+, you can select two enemy units that are within 24" of and visible to this model, instead of one. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly **^^Thousand Sons^^** unit makes an attack that targets one of those units, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Destiny's Aberration (Instant)
abilities.text: Select either this model or one other ^^**Thousand Sons^^** unit (excluding ^^**Characters^^**) from your Crusade army that has one or more Battle Traits, then select one Battle Trait the selected model/unit has and replace it with one new ^^**Thousand Sons^^** Battle Trait (this must be one it can have).

abilities.name: Arch Instigator
abilities.text: Add 2 to this model's Wounds characteristic.

abilities.name: Fickle Revelation
abilities.text: At the end of the Declare Battle Formations step, select one **^^Thousand Sons^^** Battle Trait (this can be a **^^Rubricae^^** Battle Trait, even though this model does not have that keyword, but it must otherwise be a Battle Trait this model can have and cannot be a Battle Trait this model, or the unit it is attached to, already has). Until the end of the battle, this models (and any unit it is attached to) is considered to have that Battle Trait.

abilities.name: Artful Dualism (Instant)
abilities.text: This model can either use the Renowned Heroes Requisition once, for 0RP (even if it has not gained a Crusade rank), or it can gain one Artificer or Antiquity Crusade Relic of your choice.

abilities.name: Misinformator (Battle Honour)
abilities.text: After both players have deployed their armies, you can select one **^^Thousand Sons^^** unit from your Crusade army and redeploy it. When doing so, you can set that unit up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

abilities.name: Mortal Sorcery (Aura)
abilities.text: While a friendly ^^**Scintillating Legions Psyker^^** unit from your army is within 6" of and visible to this unit, that ^^**Scintillating Legions^^** unit has the Cabal of Sorcerers ability.

abilities.name: Cabal of Sorcerers
abilities.text:
If your army Faction is ^^**Thousand Sons^^**, at the start of your Shooting phase, one or more models from your army with this ability can attempt Rituals. To do so, select one model from your army with this ability that has not yet attempted a Ritual this turn and select one Ritual no model from your army has attempted to manifest this turn, then take a Psychic test by following the sequence below:

1. Roll 2D6
2. Optionally, roll one additional D6 (Channel the Warp). Then, if one or more doubles or triples were rolled during this test, that model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
3. If that model is not destroyed, the combined total of all the dice rolled during this test is the Psychic test result. If this equals or exceeds the Warp Charge value of the Ritual being attempted, that model manifests that Ritual and you resolve its effects.

abilities.name: Blazing Salvos
abilities.text: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit that was hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the hit roll.

abilities.name: Crystalline Body
abilities.text: Each time a ranged attack is allocated to this model, on an unmodified saving throw of 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound after it has finished making its attacks.

abilities.name: Warp Strider
abilities.text: Add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in this model's unit, and each time a model in this model's unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move horizontally through models and terrain features. If this model is wholly within your opponent's deployment zone at the end of the battle, roll one D6: on a 4+, this model gains 1 Arcana point.

abilities.name: Forewarned by Fate
abilities.text: Once per battle round, when an attack is allocated to the bearer's unit, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0. abilities.name: Misinformator (Battle Honour)

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-4 wounds remaining

abilities.name: Mortal Sorcery (Aura)
abilities.text: While a friendly ^^**Scintillating Legions Psyker^^** unit from your army is within 6" of and visible to this unit, that ^^**Scintillating Legions^^** unit has the Cabal of Sorcerers ability.

abilities.name: Mutating Vortex (Aura)
abilities.text: At the end of your Movement phase, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of this model: on a 2-3, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 4-5, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that unit suffers D6 mortal wounds. abilities.name: Crystalline Body

abilities.name: Warp Strider

If your army Faction is ^^**Thousand Sons^^**, at the start of your Shooting phase, one or more models from your army with this ability can attempt Rituals. To do so, select one model from your army with this ability that has not yet attempted a Ritual this turn and select one Ritual no model from your army has attempted to manifest this turn, then take a Psychic test by following the sequence below:

2. Optionally, roll one additional D6 (Channel the Warp). Then, if one or more doubles or triples were rolled during this test, that model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Cabal of Sorcerers
abilities.text:
If your army Faction is ^^**Thousand Sons^^**, at the start of your Shooting phase, one or more models from your army with this ability can attempt Rituals. To do so, select one model from your army with this ability that has not yet attempted a Ritual this turn and select one Ritual no model from your army has attempted to manifest this turn, then take a Psychic test by following the sequence below:

1. Roll 2D6
2. Optionally, roll one additional D6 (Channel the Warp). Then, if one or more doubles or triples were rolled during this test, that model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
3. If that model is not destroyed, the combined total of all the dice rolled during this test is the Psychic test result. If this equals or exceeds the Warp Charge value of the Ritual being attempted, that model manifests that Ritual and you resolve its effects.

abilities.name: Eruption of Vitality
abilities.text:
(Once per battle, per army) When this model is destroyed, at the end of the phase, roll one D6: 
- On a 2+, set up this model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. This model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. This model has 3 wounds remaining.

abilities.name: Occulus Infernum
abilities.text: In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly **SEKHETAR ROBOTS** unit within 6" of this unit. That unit’s ranged attacks have +1 **BS** until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Walking Rampart
abilities.text:
This model has the following abilities: 
- Soul Bound: In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly **SEKHETAR ROBOTS** unit within 3" of this model. That **SEKHETAR ROBOTS** unit **heals** D3+1 wounds. 
▪ Kine‑shielded Guardians: While this model is within 3" of a friendly **SEKHETAR ROBOTS** unit, this model has **Lone Operative**.

abilities.name: Unravelled Fates
abilities.text: In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, you can select one friendly **battle‑shocked MUTANT** unit within 6" of this model. That unit is no longer **battle‑shocked**.

abilities.name: Crystalline Body
abilities.text: Each time a ranged attack is allocated to this model, on an unmodified saving throw of 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound after it has finished making its attacks.

abilities.name: Warp Strider
abilities.text: Add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in this model's unit, and each time a model in this model's unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move horizontally through models and terrain features. If this model is wholly within your opponent's deployment zone at the end of the battle, roll one D6: on a 4+, this model gains 1 Arcana point.

abilities.name: Forewarned by Fate
abilities.text: Once per battle round, when an attack is allocated to the bearer's unit, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0. If this model is within range of an objective marker that you control at the end of the battle, and that objective marker is not within your deployment zone, roll one D6: on a 4+ this model gains 1 Lore point.

abilities.name: Flesh Sigils
abilities.text: This model has the Feel Not Pain 5+ ability (if this model is a **^^Chaos Spawn^^** model, it has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead).

abilities.name: Flame-wreathed
abilities.text: Each time this model makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Raptorial Talons
abilities.text: Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of this model's melee weapons by 1.

abilities.name: Immaterial Edge
abilities.text: This model's melee weapons have the **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** ability.

abilities.name: Temporal Distortion
abilities.text: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this model's unit.

abilities.name: Aura of Illusion
abilities.text: This model has the Stealth ability, and while this model is leading a unit, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, if the attacking model is not within 12", subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Malevolence
abilities.text: At the end of the battle, this model gains 1XP and 1 Lore or Arcana point (your choice) for each different Agenda your opponent selected at the start of the battle that one or more of their units subsequently gained XP from.

abilities.name: Mirrored Machinator
abilities.text: In the Determine Victor step, if you are not the victor, roll one D6 for each model from your Crusade army with this reward that is on the battlefield. If one or more of those results are a 4+, you gain that battle's Victor Bonus anyway.

abilities.name: Exalted Mutation (Instant)
abilities.text: This model gains one Boon of Tzeentch of your choosing, or two randomly determined Boons of Tzeentch.

abilities.name: Touch of Vicissitude
abilities.text: Each time this model's unit is selected to fight, select one of the following abilities: **[LETHAL HITS]**; **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]**. Until the end of the phase, this model's melee weapons have the selected ability.

abilities.name: Empyric Portents
abilities.text: In the Determine Attacker and Defender step, if your Crusade army includes one or more models with this reward, do not roll off to determine the Attacker and Defender. Instead, you choose whether you will be the Attacker or Defender (if your opponent has a rule to the same effect, roll off as normal).

abilities.name: Guided by the Whispers
abilities.text: In the Select Crusade Blessings step, roll one D6 for each model from your Crusade army with this reward: if one or more of those result is a 4+, you can select one additional Crusade Blessing this battle.

abilities.name: Time Flux (Instant)
abilities.text:
You can either remove all Battle Scars this model has, or select one other ^^**Thousand Sons**^^ unit on your Order &
of Battle and remove one Battle Scar from that unit.

abilities.name: Psyncopation
abilities.text: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this model's unit.

abilities.name: Immaterial Echo (Psychic)
abilities.text: Each time this model manifests the Temporal Surge Ritual, if the Psychic test result for that Ritual was 12+, you can select two friendly **^^Thousand Sons^^** units that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and within 24" of and visible to this model, instead of one. Each of those units can make a Normal move up to 6". Until the end of the turn, neither of those units are eligible to declare a charge.

abilities.name: Grand Schemer (Instant)
abilities.text: Roll one D6: on a 1-3, you gain 1RP;on a 4-6, you gain D3RP.

abilities.name: Seeded Strategy
abilities.text: Each time your opponent uses a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 5, you gain 1CP; on a 6, you gain 1CP and this model gains 1 Lore point.

abilities.name: Cabal of Sorcerers
abilities.text:
If your army Faction is ^^**Thousand Sons^^**, at the start of your Shooting phase, one or more models from your army with this ability can attempt Rituals. To do so, select one model from your army with this ability that has not yet attempted a Ritual this turn and select one Ritual no model from your army has attempted to manifest this turn, then take a Psychic test by following the sequence below:

1. Roll 2D6
2. Optionally, roll one additional D6 (Channel the Warp). Then, if one or more doubles or triples were rolled during this test, that model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
3. If that model is not destroyed, the combined total of all the dice rolled during this test is the Psychic test result. If this equals or exceeds the Warp Charge value of the Ritual being attempted, that model manifests that Ritual and you resolve its effects.

If this model is within range of an objective marker that you control at the end of the battle, and that objective marker is not within your deployment zone, roll one D6: on a 4+ this model gains 1 Lore point.

abilities.name: Flesh Sigils
abilities.text: This model has the Feel Not Pain 5+ ability (if this model is a **^^Chaos Spawn^^** model, it has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead).

abilities.name: Flame-wreathed
abilities.text: Each time this model makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Raptorial Talons
abilities.text: Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of this model's melee weapons by 1.

abilities.name: Immaterial Edge
abilities.text: This model's melee weapons have the **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** ability.

abilities.name: Temporal Distortion
abilities.text: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this model's unit.

abilities.name: Aura of Illusion
abilities.text: This model has the Stealth ability, and while this model is leading a unit, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, if the attacking model is not within 12", subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Malevolence
abilities.text: At the end of the battle, this model gains 1XP and 1 Lore or Arcana point (your choice) for each different Agenda your opponent selected at the start of the battle that one or more of their units subsequently gained XP from.

abilities.name: Mirrored Machinator
abilities.text: In the Determine Victor step, if you are not the victor, roll one D6 for each model from your Crusade army with this reward that is on the battlefield. If one or more of those results are a 4+, you gain that battle's Victor Bonus anyway.

abilities.name: Exalted Mutation (Instant)
abilities.text: This model gains one Boon of Tzeentch of your choosing, or two randomly determined Boons of Tzeentch.

abilities.name: Touch of Vicissitude
abilities.text: Each time this model's unit is selected to fight, select one of the following abilities: **[LETHAL HITS]**; **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]**. Until the end of the phase, this model's melee weapons have the selected ability.

abilities.name: Empyric Portents
abilities.text: In the Determine Attacker and Defender step, if your Crusade army includes one or more models with this reward, do not roll off to determine the Attacker and Defender. Instead, you choose whether you will be the Attacker or Defender (if your opponent has a rule to the same effect, roll off as normal).

abilities.name: Guided by the Whispers
abilities.text: In the Select Crusade Blessings step, roll one D6 for each model from your Crusade army with this reward: if one or more of those result is a 4+, you can select one additional Crusade Blessing this battle.

abilities.name: Time Flux (Instant)
abilities.text:
You can either remove all Battle Scars this model has, or select one other ^^**Thousand Sons**^^ unit on your Order &
of Battle and remove one Battle Scar from that unit.

abilities.name: Psyncopation
abilities.text: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this model's unit.

abilities.name: Immaterial Echo (Psychic)
abilities.text: Each time this model manifests the Temporal Surge Ritual, if the Psychic test result for that Ritual was 12+, you can select two friendly **^^Thousand Sons^^** units that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and within 24" of and visible to this model, instead of one. Each of those units can make a Normal move up to 6". Until the end of the turn, neither of those units are eligible to declare a charge.

abilities.name: Grand Schemer (Instant)
abilities.text: Roll one D6: on a 1-3, you gain 1RP;on a 4-6, you gain D3RP.

abilities.name: Seeded Strategy
abilities.text: Each time your opponent uses a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 5, you gain 1CP; on a 6, you gain 1CP and this model gains 1 Lore point.

abilities.name: Ulterior Ruse
abilities.text: In the Select Agendas step, roll one D6 for each model from your Crusade army with this reward: if one or more of those results is a 2+, you can select one additional **^^Thousand Sons^^** Agenda this battle; if one or more of those results is a 5+, you can select two additional **^^Thousand Sons^^** Agendas instead, this battle.

abilities.name: Opus Arcana (Instant)
abilities.text: You can deduct 1 or 2 Lore points from this model: if you deduct 1, this model gains D3 Arcana points; if you deduct 2, this model gains 3 Arcana points.

abilities.name: Occult Fixation (Psychic)
abilities.text: Each time this model Channels the Warp, add 1 to the result of that Psychic test.

abilities.name: Kaleidoscopic Blast (Psychic)
abilities.text: Each time this model manifests the Doombolt Ritual, if the Psychic test result for that Ritual was 14+, you can select two enemy units that are within 24" of and visible to this model, instead of one (all other restrictions apply). Both selected units suffer D3+3 mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Ardent Scholar
abilities.text: Each time this model is Marked for Greatness, roll one D6: on a 1-2, this model gains 1 Lore point; on a 3-5, this model gains D3 Lore points; on a 6, this model gains D3 Lore points and D3XP.

abilities.name: Sacrificial Grimoire (Instant)
abilities.text: You can deduct 1 or 2 Arcana points from this model: if you deduct 1, this model gains D3 Lore points; if you deduct 2, this model gains 3 Lore points.

abilities.name: Thief of Enigmas (Psychic)
abilities.text: Each time this model manifests the Destiny's Ruin Ritual, if the Psychic test result for that Ritual was 13+, you can select two enemy units that are within 24" of and visible to this model, instead of one. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly **^^Thousand Sons^^** unit makes an attack that targets one of those units, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Destiny's Aberration (Instant)
abilities.text: Select either this model or one other ^^**Thousand Sons^^** unit (excluding ^^**Characters^^**) from your Crusade army that has one or more Battle Traits, then select one Battle Trait the selected model/unit has and replace it with one new ^^**Thousand Sons^^** Battle Trait (this must be one it can have).

abilities.name: Arch Instigator
abilities.text: Add 2 to this model's Wounds characteristic.

abilities.name: Fickle Revelation
abilities.text: At the end of the Declare Battle Formations step, select one **^^Thousand Sons^^** Battle Trait (this can be a **^^Rubricae^^** Battle Trait, even though this model does not have that keyword, but it must otherwise be a Battle Trait this model can have and cannot be a Battle Trait this model, or the unit it is attached to, already has). Until the end of the battle, this models (and any unit it is attached to) is considered to have that Battle Trait.

abilities.name: Artful Dualism (Instant)
abilities.text: This model can either use the Renowned Heroes Requisition once, for 0RP (even if it has not gained a Crusade rank), or it can gain one Artificer or Antiquity Crusade Relic of your choice.

abilities.name: Misinformator (Battle Honour)
abilities.text: After both players have deployed their armies, you can select one **^^Thousand Sons^^** unit from your Crusade army and redeploy it. When doing so, you can set that unit up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

abilities.name: Arcane Shield (Psychic)
abilities.text: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

abilities.name: Binding Tendrils (Psychic)
abilities.text: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy ^^**Infantry**^^ unit hit by one or more of those attacks made with a Psychic weapon. Until the start of your next turn, that unit is ensnared. While a unit is ensnared, subtract 2 from its Move characteristic and subtrsact 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

abilities.name: Empyric Guidance (Psychic)
abilities.text: Weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

abilities.name: Malefic Will
abilities.text: Weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

abilities.name: Marked by Fate (Psychic)
abilities.text: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks made by a Psychic weapon. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly ^^**Thousand Sons**^^ unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Swathed in Illusion
abilities.text: This unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

abilities.name: Twisted Sorceries (Psychic)
abilities.text: Once per battle, in your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, this model can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Attacks characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by this model by 3.

abilities.name: Cabal of Sorcerers
abilities.text:
If your army Faction is ^^**Thousand Sons^^**, at the start of your Shooting phase, one or more models from your army with this ability can attempt Rituals. To do so, select one model from your army with this ability that has not yet attempted a Ritual this turn and select one Ritual no model from your army has attempted to manifest this turn, then take a Psychic test by following the sequence below:

1. Roll 2D6
2. Optionally, roll one additional D6 (Channel the Warp). Then, if one or more doubles or triples were rolled during this test, that model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
3. If that model is not destroyed, the combined total of all the dice rolled during this test is the Psychic test result. If this equals or exceeds the Warp Charge value of the Ritual being attempted, that model manifests that Ritual and you resolve its effects.
